title: 3.2.B1 Build-Up — Create the Sun
description: Start the Solar System: create a large yellow Sphere at the origin with a black background.

steps.title: Create the sun Sphere
steps.instructions: In setup(), create `sun = new Sphere(0, 0, 0, 1.2)` for a large yellow sphere at the origin. Call `background('#000')` in setup() and in draw().
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Sphere section for the constructor arguments.

requirements.title: sun is a Sphere
requirements.description: A new Sphere is assigned to sun.
